high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by Kendall Jenner. The photo shows Kendall Jenner lounging on a boat, enjoying a sunny day on the water. She is wearing a blue bikini and a matching blue baseball cap, which she is holding with one hand while the other rests on her stomach. She appears to be eating a slice of watermelon, adding a casual and relaxed vibe to the scene. The setting is a calm body of water surrounded by lush green hills or mountains in the background, suggesting a serene and picturesque location.
